# Interior bike rack installation

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Install an interior bike rack by welding flat bar steel and mounting a twisty knob onto the cargo track. [t474]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Gather all necessary tools including a welder, angle grinder, thread tapping set, and short m6 x 10mm bolts.
2. [Partial] Perform mock-ups on the cargo floor to determine exactly where the bike will sit relative to the rear bumper sliders.
3. Cut the flat bar steel into three distinct sections based on your planned layout.
4. [Partial] Weld the cut sections together according to your design.
5. [Partial] Tap a couple of holes in the main flat bar section to prepare for installing the fork mount.
6. Install short m6 x 10mm bolts through the tapped holes and secure them with tiny screws so they do not protrude below the steel.
7. [Partial] Cut off one small end from another piece of flat bar stock.
8. [Partial] Tap a hole into that cut-off piece to create a threaded insert for your twisty knob.
9. Drill a hole in the main flat bar directly over the cargo track location.
10. Insert the twisted knob through the drilled hole so it threads into the previously prepared small end piece on the other side.
11. [Partial] Slide the assembly along the track until the position is correct to avoid dropping the tiny steel piece inside the tack weld area.
12. Tighten the twisty knob securely against the cargo track.
13. Mount your bicycle onto the newly installed rack.

_Procedure reported by [t474]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-extra-simple-cheap-interior-bike-rack.10048/>_
